answer: Require each agent to lock a violet-stamped bond in a shared vault before it can transact, and earn standing only through sequential, non-parallelizable work verified by randomly assigned peers. A new identity starts in the nebula of untrusted newcomers with no privileges; privileges grow only as its own work history accumulates. A sybil farmer must therefore fund, lock, and work each fake identity separately, so the cost of attacking scales linearly with the number of fakes while an honest agent pays once.
